hero.lead: Orlando to the clinic is three and a half to four hours down the Turnpike, about three and a half hours on the Brightline train, or an hour by air. Drive down Monday, get 20 porcelain veneers made in our own lab, drive home Thursday with a 5-year warranty in writing.
hero.alt: Florida's Turnpike heading south at sunrise, seen from the passenger seat
hero.caption: Orlando → Westchester, Miami · about 3 h 45 min by car · free parking at the clinic

intro: Orlando patients drive, take Brightline or fly; the clinic is just off the Turnpike in Westchester, three and a half to four hours by car. Most stay the week rather than commute, since Visits 1 and 2 fall on consecutive days. The treatment is [porcelain veneers](/porcelain-veneers-miami) at {veneerPrice} per tooth, or {price} for the 20-veneer [Smile Design](/smile-design-miami), made in the [lab one floor above your doctor](/custom-lab). Hotels, airport and what to pack are on the [out-of-state patients page](/out-of-state-patients).

gettingHere.title: Getting from Orlando to the clinic
gettingHere.aside: General guidance from the clinic. Check times with your map app and the carrier on the day; we do not sell travel.
gettingHere.alt: Calle Ocho in the early morning, the street the clinic is on

items.d: About 235 miles down the Turnpike to the Dolphin Expressway, three and a half to four hours.
Orlando to MiamiCentral in about three and a half hours, then a 20-minute rideshare.
MCO to MIA is about an hour in the air, rarely faster than the car door to door.
Leave by 6:30 am Monday to beat Miami's late-morning traffic. Parking at the clinic is free.

itinerary.title: A sample Monday-to-Thursday from Orlando, by car
itinerary.intro: Times are examples. The train or the flight slot into the same days; only the Monday morning and Thursday afternoon change.

days.d: Drive down, park at the clinic. Exam, scans and the design preview you approve.
Minimal preparation, then temporaries in the shape you approved. Afternoon free.

days.t: Free day while the lab finishes
days.d: Your veneers are finished by hand in the lab upstairs. No visit.
Shade check, bonding, bite adjusted, warranty in writing. Then the drive home.
days.time: Visit 3 about 9:00 am to 11:00 am. Leave Miami about 12:30 pm, home in Orlando around 4:30 pm.

itinerary.note: The numbness from Visit 2 wears off in a couple of hours and does not affect driving.

cost.title: What it costs to come from Orlando
cost.body: Treatment is priced from the [published price list](/veneers-cost-miami) and confirmed in writing before you book. Travel is yours; for a driver the extra cost is fuel, tolls and the hotel nights.

lines.label: Smile Design, 20 porcelain veneers
lines.note: Preview, cleaning, X-rays and the {warrantyYears}-year written warranty included

lines.label: One veneer, à la carte
lines.note: Same material, lab and warranty, for 1 to 19 teeth

lines.label: Hotel, two to four nights
lines.note: Hilton and Marriott within 10 minutes; you book directly from the list we send

lines.label: Turnpike tolls, fuel or train fare
lines.note: Not included. Parking at the clinic is free

cost.footnote: Monthly plans through six financing partners with a soft credit check. Your coordinator helps with the application before you book the hotel.

items.q: Can I drive home to Orlando the same day as delivery?
items.a: Yes. Delivery on Thursday morning takes about two hours and nothing about it stops you driving straight after. Leave after a soft lunch and you are home in Orlando by late afternoon.

items.q: Can I sleep at home and drive down for each visit?
items.a: You can, but it is four round trips of seven to eight hours each. Most Orlando patients stay Monday to Thursday at the partner rate, or drive home on the free Wednesday and return Thursday morning. Visit 1 and Visit 2 on consecutive days are easier from a hotel.

Yes. Orlando International to MiamiCentral is about three and a half hours, and the clinic is a 20-minute rideshare from the station. Take a Monday morning train and a Thursday afternoon one; check the timetable when you book.

items.q: Can I drive after Visit 2 with the numbness?
items.a: The local anesthetic wears off within a couple of hours and does not affect your ability to drive. If you would rather not drive numb, the partner hotels are within 10 minutes and a rideshare is simple.

items.q: If something needs adjusting, can I just drive down?
items.a: Yes, and being close is an advantage. Small adjustments are covered by the {warrantyYears}-year warranty at any dentist, including your own in Orlando, but a four-hour drive to the people who made the veneers is an easy call for anything beyond a polish.

items.q: Why come to Miami when there are clinics in Orlando?
items.a: Compare the same five things in writing: material, number of teeth, veneer or crown per tooth, total, and warranty. What is different here is the lab in the building, which is why the whole set is done in one week and the shade is checked on you by the ceramist. The price list is public.
